Derived values added extra rows. include meq values (result_unit == "meq/l"), charge balance anion/cation sums. fmt_wide() pivots output fmt_minimal() wide format. pivoting, resolves repeated multi-method measurements fix_multiple_measures() (R/fix.R). meq(), charge_balance() water_type() R/calculations.R. Comparison water quality guidelines R/water_quality.R. stiff_plot() R/plots.R. reactable tables R/tables.R. check_samples() (R/checks.R) validates inputs. receives raw output fetch_renmods(), applies fmt_minimal() automatically.

title: Anions and Cations
text: Charge balances calculated based formula ALS. Although EnMoDS data contains charge balances, well anion cation sums used calculate values, potential changes workflows years made difficult ascertain exactly charge balances calculated older samples. resulted discrepancies EnMoDS locally calculated charge balances. Therefore consistency, calculate charge balances samples using ALS formula . Note: means original EnMoDS charge balances, anion sums, cation sums, renamed charge_balance_enmods, anion_sum_enmods cation_sum_enmods. bcgwcat2 use created values charge_balance, anion_sum cation_sum. One difference calculation ALS, use significant digits calculating MEQ. Charge balances use following measures MEQ Anions Cl, SO4, F, NO3, NO2, Alkalinity Cations Ca, Mg, Na, K, Al, Cu, Fe, Mn, Zn, NH4, pH (lab measurements , field pH) calculated follows Anion sum=Cl+SO4+F+NO3+NO2+Alkalinity\textrm{Anion sum} = Cl + SO_4 + F + NO_3 + NO_2 + \textrm{Alkalinity} Cation sum=Ca+Mg+Na+K+Al+Cu+Fe+Mn+Zn+NH4+(10−pH)*1000 \textrm{Cation sum} = Ca + Mg + Na + K + Al +              Cu + Fe + Mn + Zn + NH_4 +              (10 ^{-\textrm{pH}}) * 1000 Charge balance=100×(Cation Sum−Anion sum)/(Cation Sum+Anion Sum)\textrm{Charge balance} = 100 \times (\textrm{Cation Sum} - \textrm{Anion sum}) / (\textrm{Cation Sum} + \textrm{Anion Sum}) Charge balances positive cations anions, negative anions cations. Anion cation sums rounded two decimal places charge balances rounded one decimal place. Charge balances checked validity rounding. Missing values ignored (.e. generally treated 0). However, values cations anions missing charge balance NA. means Charge Balances invalid many missing measures. calculations, repeated MEQ values parameter sample, first value used.
